extracted.intended_audience: Rospatent officials, patent office IT developers, patent examiners, policymakers, and stakeholders (applicants, patent attorneys)
extracted.subtask_description: Guidance and operational standards for a national patent office covering international cooperation, participation in classification bodies, Patent Prosecution Highway (PPH) activities, and the design, delivery, and functional requirements of digital/automated information systems to support IP registration, examination, and stakeholder interaction.

rubrics_metrics.name: E‑filing for international registration of industrial designs
rubrics_metrics.description: A new online service of electronic filing (e-filing) of applications for the international registration of industrial designs became available on the FIPS website via the 'My Account' section with a Russian-language interface.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: The service should facilitate filing, reduce processing and forwarding time, and reduce costs of payment of international fees compared to filing on paper; promote increased filings and attract foreign applicants.

rubrics_metrics.name: Participation in WIPO classification bodies (IPC/Locarno/NCL)
rubrics_metrics.description: Active participation in revision and improvement of the International Patent Classification (IPC), Locarno Classification and International Classification of Goods and Services (NCL/NICE).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Submit corrections and proposals (e.g., 1781 IPC corrections translated into Russian and included in the machine-readable IPC-2020.01); prepare and publish official Russian-language versions; propose additions to NCL alphabetical list for Committee consideration.

rubrics_metrics.name: Draft recommendations on 3D models and images for IPR protection
rubrics_metrics.description: As leader of the 3D Task Force, draft a questionnaire on the use of 3D among industrial property offices, analyze results and present draft recommendations on 3D models and images for WIPO Standards.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Collect cross-office input via questionnaire, analyze responses, and prepare recommendations to improve handling of 3D representations when working with objects for IPR protection.

rubrics_metrics.name: Blockchain guidelines for IPR workflows
rubrics_metrics.description: As co‑leader of the Blockchain Task Force, work out draft recommendations and a guideline on the implementation of blockchain technology when working with objects for IPR protection.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Cooperate with other offices (e.g., IP Australia), develop draft documents and present them to the Committee on WIPO Standards for adoption.

rubrics_metrics.name: Propose and adopt amendments to WIPO Standards
rubrics_metrics.description: Propose amendments to WIPO Standards (e.g., ST.3 'Two-letter codes', ST.60 'Bibliographic data relating to marks') and participate in revisions (e.g., ST.96, transition from ST.25 to ST.26).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Test related software (e.g., WIPO Sequence), submit proposals for interface and function modifications, and raise stakeholder awareness through dedicated meetings.

rubrics_metrics.name: Prepare national positions and submissions to WTO/TRIPS
rubrics_metrics.description: Prepare positions of the national party to TRIPS Council meetings and written comments to Trade Policy Reviews; notify national laws (e.g., law on geographical indications) to WTO.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Coordinate with national ministries (e.g., Ministry of Economic Development); address issues like TRIPS relationship with other conventions and e‑commerce.

rubrics_metrics.name: Capacity building and examiner training within BRICS
rubrics_metrics.description: Organize and support training of patent examiners from BRICS countries covering examination quality management, patent classification, patent search strategies, novelty and inventive step analysis.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Supervise training, present best practices, and extend cooperation on industrial designs and trademarks.

rubrics_metrics.name: Exchange and cooperation with EPO including CPC data sharing
rubrics_metrics.description: Exchange experience on patent examination; conclude cooperation programs (e.g., Two‑Year Cooperation Program) and continue sending Russian patent documents classified by CPC to EPO.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Install new CPC versions into internal systems (multiple versions per year) with automated translation into Russian; include joint focus areas such as AI and new technologies.

rubrics_metrics.name: Cooperation with EUIPO focusing on digitalization
rubrics_metrics.description: Engage at expert level with EUIPO through seminars and educational events, and involve EUIPO experts in national conferences.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Emphasize digitalization and introduction of modern ICT technologies into Patent Office activities via seminars, video conferences and practical exchanges.

rubrics_metrics.name: Regional cooperation and IPR enforcement agreements (CIS)
rubrics_metrics.description: Participate in development and signing of regional agreements (e.g., Agreement on cooperation of customs authorities of CIS member states in IPR enforcement) and integrate IP into strategic regional documents.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Coordinate CISPATENT project activities and interstate councils addressing counterfeit marks and geographical indications.

rubrics_metrics.name: Eurasian Patent Organization engagement and normative preparation
rubrics_metrics.description: Support diplomatic conferences and adoption of Protocols (e.g., Protocol on the Protection of Industrial Designs to the Eurasian Patent Convention) and prepare normative acts required for implementation.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Promote accession compatibility with international systems (e.g., Hague System), expand educational programs, and pursue ISA/IPEA status requests.

rubrics_metrics.name: PPH participation and accelerated examination procedures
rubrics_metrics.description: Operate as an Office of Later Examination receiving requests for accelerated examination under PPH and enter MOUs with other offices (e.g., Turkish PTO), and exchange PPH application data with offices like JPO.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Maintain statistics and dynamics of PPH requests; provide informational support to domestic applicants through lectures, presentations, videoconferences, consultations and website updates.

rubrics_metrics.name: Commitment to national 'Digital Economy' program deliverables and timeline
rubrics_metrics.description: Implement activities to create and operate an information system for informatization of IPR registration and protection procedures as part of the federal 'Information infrastructure' project, aiming to create 14 information systems by December 2021.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Develop and agree technical tasks with expert groups; plan staged delivery (e.g., first stage deliverables) via state and regular contracts.

rubrics_metrics.name: SIS: Management of formal checks on legally important actions
rubrics_metrics.description: Develop a system implementing formal checks at the stage of formal examination of applications for registration of trademarks and appellations of origin, and provide a designer of technological regulations for formal checks.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Commission as part of the first stage and use to automate and standardize formal examination.

rubrics_metrics.name: SIS: Smart examination system for means of individualization
rubrics_metrics.description: Provide functions for search by description by words of trademarks and optical character recognition (OCR) of individualization means filed for registration.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Use these capabilities to increase the efficiency and accuracy of examination for marks and other means of individualization.

rubrics_metrics.name: SIS: Decision‑making support system in IP
rubrics_metrics.description: Implement analytical panels (e.g., Director General panel based on execution of state task; Regional panel reflecting territorial, temporal and species sections) to support decision-making.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Enable analysis of patent activity, forecasting of priority areas, and assessment of progress toward national and federal project targets.

rubrics_metrics.name: SIS: Document management system
rubrics_metrics.description: Provide core functions for managing processes and documents, registration and processing of incoming and outgoing correspondence, and functionality focused on registration procedures of trademarks and appellations of origin.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Facilitate workflow automation and administrative transparency in registration processes.

rubrics_metrics.name: SIS: Single state digital register for results of intellectual activity
rubrics_metrics.description: Maintain a function prescribed by administrative regulations for recording to the State register information on registrations of trademarks and appellations of origin.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Serve as the authoritative, digital record for protected IP results.

rubrics_metrics.name: SIS: Documents storage management
rubrics_metrics.description: Implement a system focused on storage of information on the current workflow for registration of trademarks and appellations of origin.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Support lifecycle tracking and archival access for application materials and processing history.

rubrics_metrics.name: SIS: Distributed ledger of objects for IPR protection and means of individualization
rubrics_metrics.description: Create and operate a distributed ledger system for turnover and management of rights to trademarks (and related objects for IPR protection occurring in circulation).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Leverage distributed ledger technologies to track assignments, transfers and rights management across stakeholders.

rubrics_metrics.name: SIS: Single information workspace for internal interaction
rubrics_metrics.description: Provide an employee workspace integrating technological user services such as e-mail and access to a network file system.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Improve internal collaboration and streamline daily operations via a unified interface.

rubrics_metrics.name: SIS: Integration and management of legal and reference information
rubrics_metrics.description: Develop subsystems for internal interaction on integration of information systems and software services for maintaining legal and reference information and administration.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Ensure consistent, centrally managed legal/reference data for use by examiners and administrative staff.

rubrics_metrics.name: SIS: Omni‑channel interaction with stakeholders and public services support
rubrics_metrics.description: Implement personal account, omni-channel interaction subsystem, and administration subsystems to support specified public services (e.g., state registration of transfer under contract of exclusive rights; amendments to state registers; extension and restoration of exclusive rights; amendments to trademark/state lists).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Support at least the enumerated public services and allow applicants to transact fully online across multiple channels.

rubrics_metrics.name: SIS: Supervision of use of rights to results of intellectual activity
rubrics_metrics.description: Provide subsystem for preparation of control and supervision activities and administrative functionality for oversight.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Enable structured planning and execution of supervision/enforcement activities regarding IP rights usage.

rubrics_metrics.name: IS: Infrastructure to search for patent information and means of individualization
rubrics_metrics.description: Develop an open search platform and a search service prototype to test technological solutions forming the basis of the system.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Use prototypes to assess search technologies and to enable external program connections via API for third‑party tools.

rubrics_metrics.name: IS: Management of centralized maintenance and IT support
rubrics_metrics.description: Implement user maintenance requests management and centralized support for IT infrastructure and users.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Support operational continuity and efficient incident/request handling across office systems.

rubrics_metrics.name: Procurement and commissioning of supporting hardware and software systems
rubrics_metrics.description: Acquire and deploy systems such as secure remote access, continuity of operation, integrated information security, software-defined data processing center, basic IT systems and automated workplaces.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Ensure infrastructure and workplace environments support secure, continuous operations and digital services delivery.

rubrics_metrics.name: Supporting IS for digitalization of paper materials
rubrics_metrics.description: Develop systems focused on the digitalization of information contained in incoming paper materials of applications and correspondence on registrations of trademarks and appellations of origin.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Optimize paper processing to enable electronic workflows and archival digital records.

rubrics_metrics.name: Full digital interaction and issuance of digital protection documents
rubrics_metrics.description: Enable applicants to interact with the Patent Office fully digitally, including the issuance of digital protection documents.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Design systems and processes to eliminate paper-based interactions wherever appropriate and to support issuance and verification of digital IP certificates.

rubrics_metrics.name: Decision‑making system analytics and forecasting
rubrics_metrics.description: Use decision‑making support system to conduct analysis of patent activity based on various indicators domestically and globally, forecast priority areas of science and technology development, and assess progress in national/federal projects.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Provide analytics at national and regional levels to inform policy and strategic planning.

rubrics_metrics.name: Automatic generation and structured publication of search reports
rubrics_metrics.description: Implement automatic generation of search reports in ST.96 format to enable publication of relevant information in structured form.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Automate report creation to support structured data publication and downstream processing.

rubrics_metrics.name: Full electronic support of examination workflows and applicant interaction
rubrics_metrics.description: Deliver fully functional technological support for examination and interaction with applicants on electronic applications for inventions and utility models, including automated rules for recognizing withdrawn applications per regulatory decree.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Automate key examination lifecycle steps to increase throughput and ensure regulatory compliance (e.g., Government Decree No. 1151).

rubrics_metrics.name: Automatic verification of goods and services lists in trademark examination
rubrics_metrics.description: Implement automatic verification of goods and services lists during examination of the claimed mark, improving accuracy of automatic terminology checks and providing visual representations of verification results.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Integrate terminology checks and visualization to increase examiner efficiency and reduce classification/terminology errors.

rubrics_metrics.name: Increase uptake of digital public services and user support
rubrics_metrics.description: Increase the share of citizens using digital mechanisms of public services through improvement of personal accounts, information user support and tutorial resources.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Track metrics (e.g., percentage of electronic filings) and provide tutorials and technical support to raise e‑filing adoption.

rubrics_metrics.name: Automated registration and e‑signature integration for incoming correspondence
rubrics_metrics.description: Transition to automatic registration and uploading of incoming correspondence with an electronic signature from personal accounts to filing systems for various applications.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Reduce labor costs, shorten document delivery time to expert divisions, and eliminate manual registration errors.

rubrics_metrics.name: Expand services at Technology and Innovation Support Centers
rubrics_metrics.description: Provide additional filing services at Technology and Innovation Support Centers for applications such as utility models, appellations of origin, and exclusive rights to previously registered appellations.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Broaden user access points to filing mechanisms to support SMEs and regional applicants.

rubrics_metrics.name: Optimize paper document processing for digitization
rubrics_metrics.description: Center for data preparation should optimize paper documents processing to support their digitization and improve electronic handling.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Introduce workflows and tooling to efficiently convert incoming paper materials into machine-readable digital formats for integration into electronic systems.
